question: What cross-component proof is required to resolve this issue across managed Windows gateways and externally managed gateways?
rationale: The Windows client owns discoverability and recovery UX, while actual WhatsApp web-login availability is controlled by gateway plugin/package loading; resolution needs an agreed proof boundary covering both sides.

options.title: Prove both gateway modes
options.body: Require successful QR pairing with a provider-present gateway plus graceful Doctor/Fix recovery for a provider-missing managed or external gateway.

options.title: Ship Windows recovery first
options.body: Accept capability gating and actionable recovery in Windows while tracking provider packaging or loading as separate gateway work.

options.title: Treat as gateway-only
options.body: Keep the Windows pairing surface unchanged and resolve only the gateway package/provider loading failure.

recommendation.title: Prove both gateway modes
recommendation.body: Require successful QR pairing with a provider-present gateway plus graceful Doctor/Fix recovery for a provider-missing managed or external gateway.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Windows setup, gateway connectivity, and Command Center channel UX, which align most closely with his repository history.
